title: 2022 CODATA: proton rms charge radius is 8.4075 × 10^−16
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives proton rms charge radius as 8.4075 × 10^−16 m, with uncertainty 0.0064 × 10^−16 m.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives proton rms charge radius as 8.4075 × 10^−16 m, with uncertainty 0.0064 × 10^−16 m. The row is not marked exact. The 2022 CODATA recommended proton root-mean-square charge radius. This card records that recommendation. It does not retry the earlier muonic-hydrogen comparison, because those papers were not the file opened here.
